about: Pantry run modelled as a generic product: drawer-over-cupboard unit, sink unit with pair of doors, open bay with under-counter fridge (door, grip, kick grille), HPL worktop and upstand, stainless sink with waste and drainer with grooves, lever mixer with swan neck, wall-mounted water boiler with panel, LEDs, tap and drip tray, 2-leaf wall cupboard. Geometry is drawn at the 1800_Pantry type; the other types share it until a parametric pass. Reference: query: casework kitchen ward pantry casework hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=casework+kitchen+ward+pantry+casework+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
